label: Ждать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for ждать (to wait, await).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Жду' is the я-form, built on the stem жд- with the vowel dropping from the infinitive. 'Тебя' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Ждёшь' shows the stem жд- plus the stressed -ёшь ending. 'Уже час' marks how long the waiting has lasted.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Ждёт' is the она-form ending in -ёт. With abstract or expected things, ждать often takes the genitive, here 'важного письма'.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Ждём' shows the мы-form ending -ём on stem жд-. 'Начала концерта' is genitive, expected after ждать for an awaited event.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Ждут' is the они-form with the -ут ending. 'Хороших новостей' stands in the genitive as an awaited abstract.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Ждал' is the masculine singular past of imperfective ждать. 'Долго' stresses the drawn-out process; the perfective partner is подождать.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Ждала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Своего поезда' is genitive, and 'терпеливо' colours the ongoing wait.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Ждали' is the plural past form ending in -и. 'Гостей' is accusative-genitive for animate plurals, and 'весь вечер' marks duration.

missions.phrase: Завтра я буду ждать тебя дома.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective compound future. 'Буду ждать' joins 'буду' with the infinitive ждать. The verb is imperfective, so the future is always built this way.

missions.phrase: Жди меня здесь, я скоро вернусь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Жди' is the informal command form of ждать. It tells one person to stay and await your return.
